from_desk.macro_view: The US Dollar remains bullish with higher highs across immediate and intermediate-term signals, pressuring gold and bitcoin lower. Bond yields peaked at last week's Quad 2 cycle highs and have rolled back toward the low-end of the risk range, with the signaling process beginning to shift toward Quad 3 where cyclicals slow and secular growth leads.

Oil confirmed critical trend signal breakdown; Brent (BNO) and XOP pulled from long side after falling from $87 to $82 in two days
VIX printed 4-month lows at 15.30 remaining in Investable Bucket; VVIX declined to lowest level of year with positive gamma environment
Quad shift beginning toward Quad 3: DRAM +19.8% WoW, TAN +12.2% WoW, XLU -2.1% WoW; Indonesia IDX -16.8% over last month
